The '''P7 trauma kit''' was a type of [[medkit]] that was manufactured during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by [[Naescorcom/Legends|Naescorcom]], a company that was based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]] in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. Circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], a group of [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]] identified a [[Anti-Caarite virus|deadly virus]] that had been dispersed by the [[Believers]] [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Tilnes]] and, as a reward for making the discovery, the [[Metatheran Cartel]] gave the agents some P7 trauma kits.
